Data has been called “the oil of the digital economy” because of its immense potential. University of West Florida's Master of Science in Data Science program will give students the skills they need to innovate in a data-rich world. The data landscape is rapidly changing and transforming nearly every discipline.

In University of West Florida's Master of Science in Data Science program, students will develop expertise in mathematics, statistics, computer programming, data management, machine learning and visualization to meet the growing needs of industry, not-for-profits, government agencies and other organizations.

The Master of Science in Data Science is for students who hold bachelor’s degrees in mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, business, health or related fields.

With a focus on machine learning, software development, data storage and analysis and more, the analytics and modeling track prepares you for a career as a statistician, data engineer and project manager.

Gain a competitive edge with an affordable Master of Business Administration from the University of West Florida. Students will develop advanced management and problem-solving skills as they prepare for a leadership position.

Research shows Master of Business Administration graduates earn significantly more than those with only an undergraduate degree.

The professors are full-time faculty with doctorates and extensive professional experience. Students can pursue an Master of Business Administration at the Pensacola campus or online; designed for students needing flexible schedules.

For on-campus students University of West Florida offer a graduate assistant program, grants, and Pace and merit scholarships.

Delve into current and emerging issues facing the accounting profession, with an emphasis on research and communication skills.
